files.name: runbook-refunds.md
files.content:
# Refund runbook

1. Confirm the charge in the billing console and the reason code.
2. Refunds under 30 days: approve in full. Over 30 days: prorate by unused days.
3. Annual plans cancelled in month one: full refund minus payment fees.
4. Log the refund with the ticket number and notify the customer with the expected bank delay (5-10 days).

files.name: ticket-1042.txt
files.content:
Subject: Export to CSV fails for invoices over 10,000 rows
Customer reports the export spinner never finishes. Reproduced on the Pro plan with 12,400 invoices.
Workaround: filter by quarter and export in batches. Engineering ticket ENG-2231 opened.
Resolution: pagination added to the export job in release 4.18; customer confirmed the fix.

files.name: ticket-1043.txt
files.content:
Subject: Two-factor codes arrive late on one carrier
SMS codes take 3-5 minutes for a regional carrier. Authenticator app works instantly.
Advised switching to the authenticator app; escalated delivery delays to the SMS provider.
Resolution: provider rerouted traffic; median delivery back under 10 seconds.
